events.description: Andropov held talks in Kabul with Karmal, Savari, Gulyabzoy, Vatandjar, Nur, Zeray, Kadyr, through 1 Feb 1980.
Andropov submitted report to the CC CPSU on his discussions.
Politburo Protocol #182 approved Andropov's talks and assigned economic and party cooperation tasks.
Andropov held discussions in Kabul with Karmal, Savari, Gulyabzoy, Vatandjar, Nur, Zeray and Kadyr (Jan 31-Feb 1).
Andropov spoke with Rashidov during a stop in Tashkent on the way to Kabul.
Andropov talked with Ambassador Tabeev and party adviser head Grekov in Kabul.
Andropov submitted his report to the CC CPSU on the discussions with Afghan leaders.
Politburo Protocol #182 approved Andropov's discussions and assigned bodies to examine Afghan bridge, railway, construction and treaty-relations proposals.

key_claims: The Politburo approved Andropov's Kabul talks with Karmal and other DRA leaders in early 1980.
Moscow focused on infrastructure ties with Afghanistan, including the Termez bridge, rail branch, power, oil and Aynak copper projects.
A Politburo commission was tasked to reconsider Soviet-Afghan relations under the treaty as the situation develops.
The NDPA leadership raised party unity concerns, delivered to the CPSU in a letter.
Soviet party advisers under Grekov were embedded in Afghan party work.
